title: YulSwap
tagline: Tired of high gas fees on Uniswap? say hi to Yulswap, the most gas efficient implementation of Uniswap v1
description: Yulswap is a decentralized exchange platform that offers a gas-efficient implementation of the popular Uniswap v1 protocol. It is designed to provide users with a fast, secure, and low-cost trading experience while maintaining the key features of the original Uniswap protocol. Its build for educational purposes with a bunch of gas hack and written in modern solidity and yul.
how_its_made:
Yulswap is a remade version of the popular Uniswap protocol that focuses on delivering a highly gas-efficient trading experience. The project was built from the ground up, taking into account the latest advancements in blockchain technology and gas-saving techniques.
The development team behind Yulswap conducted extensive research and analysis of the Uniswap protocol to identify areas where gas efficiency could be improved.
